'''Anatoly Ivanovich Akishin''' ({{langx|ru|Анатолий Иванович Акишин}}; born 9 June 1926) is a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and Russian scientist in the field of space materials science and [[nuclear physics]], [[professor]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://dbserv.sinp.msu.ru:8080/sinp/new/export/opeople/akishin.html|title=Акишин Анатолий Иванович}}</ref>

== Biography ==
He was born on 9 June 1926 in [[Moscow]].

In 1950 he graduated from the [[Moscow Power Engineering Institute]], in 1958 defended his thesis, in 1977 he was awarded the title of professor.<ref name=":0" />

He carried out research work in the field of physical electronics, [[Health physics|radiation physics]], [[forecasting]] and imitation of the impact of various space factors on materials and elements of space vehicles, testing materials of a [[thermonuclear reactor]], radiation technology.<ref name=":1" />

In 1979 he received the [[USSR State Prize|State Prize of the USSR]] as a member of a group of scientists for his work in the field of space research.<ref name=":0" />

As a scientist, he became famous for the studies related to methods of simulating the effects of the space environment on materials and elements of space vehicles.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/4677|title=Акишин Анатолий Иванович}}</ref>
